units.source_text: 古歌：“缁衣修道处，何用女郎花？

en.t: An old poem says: In a place where one wears black robes and cultivates the Way, what need is there for maidenflowers?

units.source_text: 人世多谣诼，传闻殊不佳。”见《后撰集》。

en.t: In this world there is much slander, and the rumors are especially unfavorable. It appears in the Gosen Wakashu.
